deletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
deletion.intro: You can ask us at any time to delete your Bibliaris account and the personal data associated with it.
deletion.step1: Send an email to {b} asking us to delete your account.
deletion.step2: We will delete your profile data (email, name, avatar and bookshelf entries) from our database within {hours} hours.
deletion.confirmationBody: Upon receiving and processing your request, we will send a confirmation email to the address associated with your profile confirming that all personal information has been permanently removed from our active databases.
